live.name: GOLD HARVEST
live.headline: GOLD HARVEST: a threat actor tracked under several names
live.in_short: The catalogue lists GOLD HARVEST under five other names and names three remote-access tools tied to it. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: The catalogue record, sourced to Secureworks, tracks the actor as GOLD HARVEST.
The same record lists these aliases: Octo Tempest, Roasted 0ktapus, Scatter Swine, Scattered Spider and UNC3944.
The record lists three tools: AnyDesk, ConnectWise Control and Logmein.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.headline: GOLD HARVEST: a financially motivated group also tracked as Scattered Spider
next.in_short: GOLD HARVEST goes by many names, including Scattered Spider and UNC3944. CrowdStrike describes it as a prolific eCrime actor active since early 2022. Early targets were outsourcing, telecom and tech firms.

sentences.t: GOLD HARVEST is also known as Octo Tempest, Roasted 0ktapus, Scatter Swine, Scattered Spider and UNC3944.
CrowdStrike lists further aliases for the same actor: Storm-0875 and LUCR-3.
CrowdStrike describes Scattered Spider as a prolific eCrime adversary that has run a range of financially motivated activity since early 2022.
According to CrowdStrike, early campaigns reportedly targeted customer relationship management and business-process outsourcing firms.
CrowdStrike also lists telecommunications and technology companies as targets.
CrowdStrike's profile lists the United States and the United Kingdom among the regions involved, along with Western Europe, North America, the Americas and Europe.
The catalogue record lists three remote-access tools for the group: AnyDesk, ConnectWise Control and Logmein.
Intrinsec's report on the Vidar infostealer cites a CISA advisory of 29 July 2025 on Scattered Spider. Per the card, the advisory names Vidar among tools the group used.
